desc: Expertly crafted with a blend of traditional methods and western design, the Citori 825 Lariat Sporting is an over and under shotgun that is as impressive as it is functional. The Lariat Trap is a great representative of Browning over and under shotgun greatness. Its receiver sets it apart from any other trap shotgun on the market with an extensive scroll engraving that features hand-chiseled rope borders and horseshoes. A gloss oil finish Grade III Turkish walnut stock is designed with a vertical grip and palm swell. This beautiful wood is protected by a premium gloss oil finish that accentuates the contrasting wood grain. Fine-line checkering and a semi-beavertail forearm with finger grooves are added to the stock and forearm for enhanced grip and swing. The raised Monte Carlo comb puts your eye in direct alignment with the wide high-post rib and HiViz Pro-Comp fiber-optic front sight. A vertical grip with palm swell and adjustable Triple Trigger System aid in obtaining a consistent set-up between shots. The barrels are coated with a non-reflective matte blue finish. Beyond the beauty, the Lariat is all Citori 825, the latest in the storied lineage of Browning over and under shotguns. Like the B25 and other Citori models, Citori 825 shotguns rely on the blueprint of the renowned full-width hinge and tapered locking lug design to provide maximum durability and unstoppable reliability for a shotgun that will outlast every other.
